**What do you want?**
A clear description of the feature.

**Why is this useful?**
How would this help you or other students?

**Any ideas on how to build it?**
Optional — but if you've thought about implementation, share it.

**Would you be willing to work on this?**
Yes / No / Maybe with some guidance
